title: Create Deal Request
description: Request parameters for creating a deal on an SSP platform. Supports two modes: (1) Direct mode — provide segment_ids with explicit segment selections, or (2) Proposal mode — provide proposal_id and total_budget to execute a proposal from get_segments. One of segment_ids or proposal_id must be provided. Each call activates on a single SSP platform — for multi-platform activation, make separate calls.

buyer_ref.description: Buyer's reference identifier for this deal. Curators SHOULD deduplicate requests with the same buyer_ref and account, returning the existing deal rather than creating a duplicate SSP deal.

buyer_campaign_ref.description: Buyer's campaign reference label. Groups related discovery and deal operations under a single campaign.

account.description: Account to bill for this deal.

segment_ids.description: Selected segment IDs for direct mode. Segments must be from a previous get_segments response and must support the specified platform.

proposal_id.description: ID of a proposal from get_segments to execute. When provided with total_budget, the curator converts the proposal's allocation percentages into segment selections automatically.

total_budget.description: Total budget for the deal when executing a proposal. The curator applies the proposal's allocation percentages to this amount.

platform_id.description: SSP platform to activate this deal on. Must be a platform_id from list_platforms. One deal per SSP — multi-platform activation requires separate create_deal calls.

deal_type.description: Type of SSP deal to create. Defaults to 'curated' if omitted. Must be supported by the target platform (check list_platforms).

dsps.description: DSP configurations — which DSPs should receive this deal. Each entry must include the buyer's seat_id on the SSP for that DSP.

dsp_id.description: DSP identifier (must match a supported DSP on the target platform)

seat_id.description: Buyer's seat ID on the SSP for this DSP. This is the buyer's identity on the SSP-DSP integration — the SSP routes the deal to this seat.

pricing.description: CPM pricing for this deal. Use floor_price for curated/PMP deals (auction-based), fixed_price for guaranteed or preferred deals.

ad_format_types.description: Ad format types for this deal. If omitted, the deal inherits formats from the selected segments.

start_time.description: Campaign start date/time in ISO 8601 format

end_time.description: Campaign end date/time in ISO 8601 format

push_notification_config.description: Optional webhook configuration for async deal activation status notifications. Curator will send webhooks when deal status changes.
